answer_1.quote: We build a benchmark suite composed of eight benchmarks spanning both descriptive and normative forms. Each of the eight benchmarks comprises 2,000 questions, totaling 16,000 questions.
tasks: Other:fairness evaluation in generative language models
datasets: our benchmark suite with 8 benchmarks and 16,000 questions
